title: The PULI Language Model
goal: I can describe the PULI language model and who developed it (*PULI modell, Nyelvtudományi Kutatóközpont, korpuszépítés*).
I can say that the more training text a model has, the better it handles Hungarian, with *minél … annál …*.
I can report what developers expect from a Hungarian language model, naming whose expectation it is.
